about: Files old trillion deleted in 4ffa1dc4a2 whose exact bytes were already here: each file's bytes at the parent of that commit (commit) are the bytes of `to` here (identity), or were at byte_copy_commit before this repository changed them (identity_at_move). Found by matching git blobs across the four repositories; nothing was copied or rewritten for this receipt.
its_words: Retire old trillion's Worker and everything only it reached: nothing live runs it (the public door is the Hetzner relay, the Mac engine is trillion-rust's trillion-local), and 7fd8838475 had already deleted 110 modules its graph imports, so it could no longer build.
